payload.title: ODI filing: what to prepare

items.text: WeBank's written consent as your lender (the reply to your consent request)

source.label: 流动资金贷款管理办法 (2024) Art. 25(3): the lender's consent

items.text: The NDRC project filing form for the Singapore shop, filed with the Shenzhen DRC

source.label: State Council Decree 837 Art. 27; NDRC Order 11 (企业境外投资管理办法): project filing

items.text: The Commerce Bureau outbound investment filing form, filed online, for the investment certificate

source.label: MOFCOM Order 2014 No. 3 (境外投资管理办法): enterprise filing and the outbound investment certificate
State Council Decree 837 Art. 27; NDRC Order 11 (企业境外投资管理办法): project filing

items.text: A shareholders' or board decision approving the Singapore investment

source.label: State Council Decree 837 Art. 27; NDRC Order 11 (企业境外投资管理办法): project filing

items.text: Proof the money comes from the company's own profit and savings: recent financial statements and the set-aside account statements

source.label: Waypoint plan rules R1, R3, R7 (rules/rules.yaml)

items.text: A note that nothing in China guarantees the Singapore company's obligations

source.label: Waypoint plan rules R1, R3, R7 (rules/rules.yaml)

items.text: If you need money before the company exists: the pre-investment allowance (前期费用) request, never for the lease deposit

source.label: SAFE capital account guide (2024) §8.1: 前期费用 and ODI registration
